newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Small premium seen at Brazil CVRD auction - report.
newsitem.headline: Small premium seen at Brazil CVRD auction - report.

text.p: The vice-president of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said he expects a small premium to be achieved on the minimum price at the privatization auction of state mining giant CVRD, a local news agency said.
A 45-percent voting stake in CVRD is being auctioned April 29 for a minimum price of 3 billion reais ($2.83 billion) as a first step in the company's privatization.
Jose Pio Borges said he expected two consortia to bid at the auction which would result in a small premium of 10 to 15 percent on the base price, Agencia Estado said.

He said one of the emerging groups forming around Brazilian metal, cement and pulp group Votorantim was close to concluding a deal by next week to form a consortium with South Africa's Anglo American Corp and Brazilian pension funds among others.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
